heading.title: First Division · Part IX · Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article103Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part IX—Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters
To make good out of the general estate of a deceased trustee the loss occasioned by a breach of trust.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of the trustee's death or if the loss has not then resulted, the date of the loss.
